title: The Fall of Jerusalem

questions.question: In what year of Zedekiah's reign did Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army come against Jerusalem and besiege it?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 39:1 (ESV): "In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army came against Jerusalem and besieged it."

questions.question: In the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, on the ninth day of the month, what happened to the city?
options: A breach was made in the city
questions.correctAnswer: A breach was made in the city
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 39:2 (ESV): "in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, on the ninth day of the month, a breach was made in the city."

questions.question: When Zedekiah and all the soldiers saw the Babylonian officials in the Middle Gate, what did they do?
options: They fled and went out of the city by night
questions.correctAnswer: They fled and went out of the city by night
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 39:4 (ESV): "When Zedekiah king of Judah and all the soldiers saw them, they fled, going out of the city at night by way of the king's garden..."

questions.question: Where did the Chaldean army overtake Zedekiah?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 39:5 (ESV): "But the army of the Chaldeans pursued them and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho."

questions.question: The Chaldeans brought Zedekiah to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon at Riblah. What did the king of Babylon do to the sons of Zedekiah?
options: He slaughtered them before his eyes
He exiled them to Babylon as slaves
He let them live in Riblah
questions.correctAnswer: He slaughtered them before his eyes
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 39:6 (ESV): "The king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah at Riblah before his eyes."

questions.question: What did the king of Babylon do to Zedekiah physically after killing his sons?
options: He put out Zedekiah's eyes and bound him with chains
He cut off his thumbs and big toes
He threw him in a fire
questions.correctAnswer: He put out Zedekiah's eyes and bound him with chains
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 39:7 (ESV): "He put out the eyes of Zedekiah and bound him in chains to take him to Babylon."

questions.question: What did the Chaldeans do to the king's house and the houses of the people, and the walls of Jerusalem?
options: They burned the houses with fire and broke down the walls
They fortified them to live in them
They left them standing as a warning
questions.correctAnswer: They burned the houses with fire and broke down the walls
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 39:8 (ESV): "The Chaldeans burned the king's house and the houses of the people, and broke down the walls of Jerusalem."

questions.question: Who was the captain of the guard who carried into exile to Babylon the rest of the people left in the city?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 39:9 (ESV): "Then Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, carried into exile to Babylon the rest of the people who were left in the city,"

questions.question: Who did Nebuzaradan leave in the land of Judah, giving them vineyards and fields at the same time?
options: The poor people who owned nothing
questions.correctAnswer: The poor people who owned nothing
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 39:10 (ESV): "Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, left in the land of Judah some of the poor people who owned nothing, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time."

questions.question: What command did Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon give concerning Jeremiah?
options: "Take him, look after him well, and do him no harm, but deal with him as he tells you."
"Bring him to Babylon in chains so I can question him."
"Put him to death for prophesying the fall of the city."
"Leave him in the cistern to die."
questions.correctAnswer: "Take him, look after him well, and do him no harm, but deal with him as he tells you."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 39:12 (ESV): "Take him, look after him well, and do him no harm, but deal with him as he tells you."

questions.question: The Babylonians took Jeremiah from the court of the guard and entrusted him to whom, to take him home?
options: Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, son of Shaphan
questions.correctAnswer: Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, son of Shaphan
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 39:14 (ESV): "and they entrusted him to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, son of Shaphan, that he should take him home. So he lived among the people."

questions.question: The word of the Lord had come to Jeremiah while he was shut up in the court of the guard, telling him to speak a message to a specific person. Who was the recipient of this message?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 39:15-16 (ESV): "The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah while he was shut up in the court of the guard: 'Go, and say to Ebed-melech the Ethiopian...'"

questions.question: What did the Lord promise Ebed-melech regarding the day when disaster comes upon Jerusalem?
options: "I will deliver you on that day... you shall not be given into the hand of the men of whom you are afraid."
"You will be made governor over Judah."
"You will be given the wealth of the king's house."
"You will return to your own country in peace."
questions.correctAnswer: "I will deliver you on that day... you shall not be given into the hand of the men of whom you are afraid."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 39:17 (ESV): "But I will deliver you on that day, declares the Lord, and you shall not be given into the hand of the men of whom you are afraid."

questions.question: Because Ebed-melech put his trust in the Lord, what did the Lord say he would have as a prize of war?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 39:18 (ESV): "but you shall have your life as a prize of war, because you have put your trust in me, declares the Lord."

questions.question: In verse 3, where did all the officials of the king of Babylon come and sit after the city wall was breached?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 39:3 (ESV): "all the officials of the king of Babylon came and sat in the middle gate:"

key_verse_text: The king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah at Riblah before his eyes, and the king of Babylon slaughtered all the nobles of Judah. He put out the eyes of Zedekiah and bound him in chains to take him to Babylon.
